GET /api/dealer/active-map ignores journeys whose current_position is missing rather than falling back to route[0] — currently harmless because journeys always seed current_position/from_coords.
test_credentials: Rider session_token=testtoken123 (usr_test1); Dealer session_token=dealertoken123 (usr_dealer1, role=dealer). Both pre-seeded per problem statement.
